title: Topic 1.3: Climatic regions in Eastern Africa

pages.lesson:
LESSON: CLIMATIC REGIONS IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.3: Climatic regions in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can climate influence our day-to-day activities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
4. Show that you can: identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Climatic regions in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the characteristics of climatic regions in Eastern Africa, and make class presentations.
2. Digital literacy: Learners observe safety precautions and practices as they use digital devices/print resources to draw the main climatic regions of Eastern Africa
3. Disaster risk reduction: Learners are equipped with knowledge on disaster risk reduction as they compose poems that address effects of climatic change on human activities
4. Decision-making skills: Learners are able to make choices as they use digital/print media to find out how climate influences human activities Values:
5. Social Justice: Learners accord equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities as they compose poems that address effects of climatic change on human activities

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe characteristics of the main climatic regions in Eastern Africa
3. explain ways in which climate influences human activities in Eastern Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
